name: @media-router/plugin-video-player
description: Video player — MPEG-TS input rendered to a DRM/HDMI display

mediaRouter.description: Decodes an MPEG-TS video stream and renders it to a display via DRM/KMS

fallbackText.description: Overlay text when no stream is connected

fallbackImagePath.description: Image shown as fallback when no stream (otherwise SMPTE colour bars).

bufferMs.description: Pre-decode buffer. Keep low (200) for live SRT/RIST; raise (e.g. 1500) for HLS so the decoder has lookahead until the next I-frame after a mid-stream join. Adds end-to-end latency.

qos.description: Sink QoS. When ON (default), the sink can ask the decoder to drop frames if it falls behind — right for live SRT/RIST where keeping up matters more than completeness. Turn OFF for HLS so every decoded frame is presented; pairs with a larger bufferMs.

sync.description: Honour buffer PTS. OFF (default): the sink presents frames as fast as they arrive — right for live SRT/RIST where latency dominates. ON: the sink waits to present each frame at its PTS — turn on for HLS so playback flows at the media's intended rate instead of speeding up on segment bursts and stalling between segments.

clockSync.description: Lock to the shared engine clock so video stays in sync with an audio-decoder fed from the same source — the fix for audio/video drift when one stream is split into separate video + audio playout. Turn ON here AND on the matching audio-decoder. Forces PTS-accurate playback. Leave OFF for standalone/low-latency video.

lipSyncMs.description: Lip-sync trim. Positive DELAYS video to meet audio that's playing late (the audio path usually carries more buffering latency); negative advances it. Adjust live while watching until lips match. Only applies with Clock sync (or Sync) on.
